specialists.purpose: Practical UI/UX design, improvement, visual critique and technical UI audit
specialists.authority: Advisory; AIPF, approved requirements and current authorization govern
specialists.activation: Material user-facing UI design, improvement, critique or technical audit after canonical Chapter 14 routing; not unrelated coding or trivial edits.
specialists.output: Source-linked candidate references and applied guidance; distinguish observations from recommendations and respect licensing.
specialists.fallback: Use approved project context and available craft when sufficient; disclose unavailable guidance or retrieval; never fabricate references.

specialists.purpose: Context-grounded software architecture and engineering design decisions, evolution and critique
specialists.authority: Advisory; AIPF, approved requirements and current authorization govern
specialists.activation: Material architecture decision, structural diagnosis, change to boundaries/data/contracts, or technology evaluation after canonical AIPF routing; not incidental code edits or chapter presence alone.
specialists.output: Suitable options including no change, tradeoffs, assumptions, implementation constraints and verification implications, source-linked when material.
specialists.fallback: Disclose missing guides or facts; use verified project context and qualified alternatives only where sufficient, otherwise identify the material decision gap.

specialists.purpose: Context-grounded defensive security and privacy design, hardening and source assessment
specialists.authority: Advisory; AIPF, approved requirements and current authorization govern
specialists.activation: Material security/privacy intent or trust/data boundary change after canonical AIPF routing; not chapter presence or minor unrelated work.
specialists.output: Conditional controls, alternatives, trust/data invariants, positive/negative verification and source-bound findings with evidence limits.
specialists.fallback: Disclose unavailable guidance or facts; continue only with sufficient verified approved context, otherwise identify decision or observation gap.

specialists.purpose: Context-grounded test design, diagnosis, regression, test effectiveness and engineering-quality critique
specialists.authority: Advisory; AIPF, approved requirements and current authorization govern
specialists.activation: Material verification strategy, failure diagnosis, test effectiveness or engineering-quality review after canonical AIPF routing; not chapter presence, routine tests or trivial unrelated changes alone.
specialists.output: Risk-selected methods and observables, causal diagnosis, source-bound findings and evidence limits with relevant alternatives.
specialists.fallback: Disclose unavailable guidance, tool, source or observer; proceed only with sufficient verified approved context and qualified alternatives, otherwise identify material decision or observation gap.

specialists.purpose: Context-grounded operations design, diagnosis and review for delivery, infrastructure, reliability, runtime, repository lifecycle and cost
specialists.authority: Advisory; AIPF, approved requirements and current authorization govern
specialists.activation: Material operational, delivery, runtime, reliability or repository lifecycle decision after canonical AIPF routing; not chapter presence, routine verification or trivial documentation alone.
specialists.output: Suitable alternatives including no change, operational effects, authority and cost/privacy constraints, source-bound evidence, causal diagnosis and recovery implications.
specialists.fallback: Disclose unavailable guidance, source, target, telemetry, tool or observer; continue only where verified approved context and alternatives suffice, otherwise identify material decision or observation gap.
